hero_description: C.Zara Enterprise sells natural honey, cashew nuts, groundnuts and red palm oil to households and businesses in Abuja. Message or call and we will confirm today's price and delivery.
values_description: There is no online checkout. You tell us what you need and we sort out the rest with you directly.
feature_1_description: Tell us which products you want and how much.
feature_2_description: We reply with today's price, what is available and the delivery details.
feature_3_description: C.Zara is run from Kurudu, FCT, Abuja, and serves customers around Abuja.
